cases.name: typical: ID flag toggles, so CPUID is present; returns 1
repeat call: same result, nothing kept between calls

coverage_ok.100244AC-100244B3: the 0 path (ID flag won't toggle, i.e. a CPU without CPUID) needs a flag-stuck CPU; the emulator always keeps EFLAGS.ID writable, and the function reads no input, so the harness can't reach it
